data.one_liner: A clean MVVM state management solution for Flutter using the Provider package and hooks.
data.what_it_does: PMVVM separates the UI (View) from state and business logic (ViewModel and Model). It uses the Provider package underneath to manage reactivity and provides built-in lifecycle methods inside ViewModels.
use_when: You want an MVVM architecture without the heavy boilerplate of other state management libraries.
Your widget has its own events that mutate state directly (e.g., pages, posts).
avoid_when: You prefer pure BLoC, Riverpod, or Redux architectures for your entire application.
You do not want to use the Provider package.
strengths: Simple and clean API with low boilerplate.
Allows direct access to the BuildContext inside ViewModels.
Supports observables for fine-grained reactivity and history tracking.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on the Provider package ecosystem.
May require adapting to its specific View and ViewModel structure.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want raw Provider without the MVVM wrapper classes.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer event-driven state management using BLoC/Cubit patterns.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want compile-safe global state management without BuildContext dependency.
